links.comparator_used: Uniform manual review of all cases (implied by the stated 75% reduction in review burden)
links.outcome: Classification accuracy (weighted F1) by uncertainty level, and manual review burden
links.effect: Weighted F1 for low- vs high-uncertainty cases: 0.94 vs 0.57 in stage 1 and 0.82 vs 0.58 in stage 2. Overall F1 reached 0.955 after manual review of the remaining uncertain cases. Manual review burden fell by 75%.
links.tradeoff: High-uncertainty cases performed poorly and still needed manual review: 285 of 1072 test cases went to chart review.
links.quote: Low-uncertainty cases consistently outperformed high-uncertainty cases in both stages (weighted F1-scores: 0.94 vs 0.57 in stage 1 and 0.82 vs 0.58 in stage 2).

links.comparator_used: Stage 1 alone (zero-shot ensemble applied to all cases)
links.tradeoff: Stage 3 relies on manual chart review for the final uncertain cases, and high-uncertainty cases still performed poorly in stage 2 (F1 0.58).
links.quote: The overall framework performance showed a progressive improvement in F1-scores from 0.840 (stage 1) to 0.878 (stage 2) to 0.955 (stage 3).
